title: Config path fields use String instead of PathBuf
description: cert_path, key_path, signing_key_path, index_dir, cache_path, credential_file, queue_dir, and similar fields in reader/config.rs, imap/config.rs, and auth/config.rs are typed Option<String> despite representing filesystem paths. Idiomatic Rust uses Option<PathBuf> for path-typed fields so that callers get a typed value and do not need to call Path::new() at every use site. The current pattern also prevents the type system from catching path vs. non-path confusion (e.g. passing a URL where a path is expected). The change is mechanical: update field types, add #[serde(deserialize_with = ...)] or PathBuf's built-in Deserialize impl.
